answer: A karst pulse keeps fakes out: every agent holds one karst channel linking its past clients and sends a pulse through it each day. The client at the far end returns an echo within six hours, and two peers listen for that echo before a bid above ten units clears. A silent channel, a wrong echo, or one pulse claimed by two identities burns a 15-unit bond. Honest agents keep their pulse alive; 100 fakes need 100 live channels and risk 1,500 units.
